text.en: As architecture students, we are all well aware of the importance of an ideal workspace. Especially during the Covid pandemic, many people are often faced with
text.zh: 作为建筑学生，我们深知理想工作空间的重要性。尤其在新冠疫情期间，许多人常常面临

text.en: the challenge of managing work, rest, and socializing in the same room, a limitation that not only affects productivity but can also exacerbate emotional isolation.
text.zh: 在同一房间内安排工作、休息与社交的挑战，这一限制不仅影响生产力，也可能加剧情感孤立。

text.en: For those in the creative industries, it is particularly important to have a meeting of inspirations, an exchange of ideas, and the opportunity to show their work
text.zh: 对于创意行业工作者，灵感的相遇、想法的交流，以及定期向他人展示作品的机会

text.en: to others on a regular basis. Therefore, the goal of this project is to design a building that provides studios for artists and small businesses, creating a shared
text.zh: 尤其重要。因此，本项目旨在设计一栋为艺术家和小型企业提供工作室的建筑，创造共享

text.en: space that not only inspires creativity but also fosters community interaction.
text.zh: 空间，既激发创造力，也促进社区互动。

text.en: The site is located between Tithebarn Street, Moorefields, and Hackins Hey in Liverpool, England.
text.zh: 场地位于英国利物浦 Tithebarn Street、Moorefields 与 Hackins Hey 之间。

text.en: There is an existing parking lot adjacent to the site.
text.zh: 场地旁有一个现有停车场。

text.en: There is a derelict existing building on the site.
text.zh: 场地内有一栋现有废弃建筑。

text.en: There are two streets adjacent to the site that will influence the design of the building’s entrance.
text.zh: 场地旁有两条街道，将影响建筑入口的设计。

text.en: The site is next to a pub, and the design should consider the relationship between the building and itself.
text.zh: 场地旁是一家酒吧，设计应考虑建筑与其自身的关系。

text.en: Install polycarbonate boards on the sides exposed to direct sunlight to reduce glare.
text.zh: 在受到阳光直射的立面安装聚碳酸酯板，以减少眩光。

text.en: For sides not exposed to direct sunlight, use adjustable
text.zh: 在没有阳光直射的立面，使用可调节的

text.en: polycarbonate boards that users can control as required.
text.zh: 聚碳酸酯板，让使用者按需控制。
